defects.detail: Zone M1 is 2.94:1 but the shot s09-styles-row-cream.png is 4.73:1. The compositor filled the gap above and below the tiles with the shot's edge colour, RGB(185,188,171), a grey-green that is not in the palette. That leaves two flat bands of about 58 px each, roughly 37% of the panel, while the tiles run flush to the left and right edges. It looks like an unfilled placeholder sitting inside the cream frame.
defects.fix: Re-run the composite for M1 with the letterbox pad set to the plate's paper colour (RGB 252,251,242 / #FCFBF2) instead of the edge colour. Better still, build the shot at 2.94:1: cream top and bottom margins, about 16 px cream side margins, tiles centred. Alternative: regenerate the plate with the zone described as 'a wide, short framed keying zone about 84% of the page width and about 15% of the page height (aspect about 4.7:1)', and give the freed ~110 px to a larger code box and caption.

defects.fix: Patch in post: re-set 'Claude' in the same upright regular grotesk, using step 2's 'Claude Code' as the glyph source. Or run an edit pass: 'In step 1, set the words "Claude Code" in upright regular weight exactly like step 2; no italic anywhere on the slide.'

defects.fix: If the plate is regenerated, ask for the code box text at 30 px or more and let it wrap to two lines ('/animate a 45-second history' / 'of the bicycle, cut paper'). Set the caption at body size too. Shrinking zone M1 to about 4.7:1 frees the space.
